content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to create a new task with a title, a due date and a priority","so_that":"I can record work I need to do and track it in my task list","business_description":"Users need to add tasks to their personal to-do list. Each new task stores a title (mandatory), an optional description, a priority (Low, Medium or High), a due date and a creation date. The backend validates the input and saves the task only when all rules pass. The frontend shows success only after the backend confirms the save.","business_value":"Users can capture their to-do items in one place with the fields needed for later tracking, reporting and filtering. Validation prevents tasks without a title and tasks whose due date is before the creation date.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"the task creation form is open with a non-empty Title and a Due Date equal to or later than today","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend saves a new task with a unique ID, the Creation Date set to the current date and the entered fields, and the form shows the message 'Task created'"},{"given":"the task creation form is open with an empty Title","when":"the user submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the request, the task is not saved, and the form shows an error message stating that the title is required"},{"given":"a new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"the user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-09","then":"the backend rejects the task, nothing is saved, and the form shows an error message that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date"},{"given":"the backend returns an error or cannot be reached when the user submits a new task","when":"the request fails","then":"the form shows an error message and does not show the task as created"},{"given":"the task creation form is open","when":"the user selects a priority","then":"only Low, Medium and High can be selected"}],"edge_cases":["Due Date equal to the Creation Date (same day) is accepted, because the rule rejects only dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A Title containing only spaces: the PRD says the title cannot be empty but does not say whether whitespace-only titles are rejected. Open question.","Description is not described as mandatory in the PRD, so an empty Description is assumed to be accepted. Open question to confirm.","The PRD does not state a default Status for a new task. The task list and report depend on it. Open question to confirm; the data model lists Open, In Progress and Completed as allowed values.","The Due Date is entered in a form that the PRD does not define (date only or date and time).
